description: Categorized held-out evaluation prompts (v2), applied AFTER fitting; never part of the fitted Jacobian corpus and disjoint from the WikiText fitting distribution. Deterministic, lightweight, self-contained probe set — NOT a comprehensive benchmark. Plain-text and chat-templated prompts are evaluated and aggregated separately (chat entries are rendered with the tokenizer's chat template at eval time). 'positions' use Python indexing into the tokenized sequence. Loaded by jlens.evaluation.load_eval_prompts_v2.
